gholam.text:
رفیق، دم و دستگاه آنتروپیک درها رو باز کرده و برای دو تا دوره فلوشیپ خفن ثبت‌نام راه انداخته؛ یکی تو حوزه علوم پایه و مهندسی و اون یکی هم استدلال مفهومی که رشته‌هایی مثل فلسفه، علوم شناختی، اقتصاد و حقوق رو در بر می‌گیره. ماجرا اینه که قراره این متخصص‌ها چهار ماه تمام تو دل آنتروپیک مستقر بشن تا به مدل هوش مصنوعی کلود یاد بدن چطوری تو پیچیده‌ترین چالش‌های فکری این رشته‌ها درست‌ودرمون استدلال کنه. خلاصه اگر کسی اهل این مباحث باشه، تا ۲۸ اکتبر بیشتر وقت نداره تا دست بجنبونه و ثبت‌نامش رو نهایی کنه.

اهمیتش اینه که غول‌های فناوری فهمیدن برای ارتقای هوش مصنوعی فقط به مهندس و کدنویس نیاز ندارن، بلکه به دانشمند و فیلسوف هم محتاجن تا ماشین بتونه منطق و استدلال عمیق انسانی رو یاد بگیره.

links.text:
Applications are now open for two new Anthropic Fellowships.

STEM Fellows (science and engineering) and Conceptual Reasoning Fellows (philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law) will spend four months at Anthropic from January 2027, working to help Claude reason well about some of the hardest problems in those fields.

For more information, see the descriptions below. The application deadline is October 28.

Conceptual Reasoning Fellows: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5447080008

STEM Fellows: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5452403008

links.title: Conceptual Reasoning Fellow
links.description: Remote-Friendly, United States; San Francisco, CA
links.text:
Conceptual Reasoning Fellow
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
Program Overview
Many of the questions that will shape our future have no single checkable answer. Reasoning well about them, whether in law, policy, philosophy, economics, cognitive science, or AI safety itself, takes the kind of judgment experts spend years building. We believe frontier AI, developed safely, can become a real partner on these questions, but getting there means working closely with the people who know these fields best.
This fellowship brings researchers and experts from philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy, and law into Anthropic for four months to work alongside our research teams. Fellows pair deep domain expertise with our frontier models and internal tooling to evaluate, improve, and apply Claude's capabilities in their field.
What to Expect:
- A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with mentorship from Anthropic researchers.
- Access to frontier Claude models and internal evaluation tooling.
- A cohort of incoming Fellows to collaborate with and a connection to Anthropic's broader research community.
Compensation:
$100,000–$167,000 USD for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to $300,000–$500,000 USD annualized), and other benefits.
Key responsibilities
- Identifying key open problems in your field, assessing approaches to solving them, and using Claude to make progress on them.
- Identifying grand societal challenges which the expertise of your field is crucial for addressing, and assessing Claude’s strengths and weaknesses in tackling them.
- Designing evaluations and RL environments that test models in your field systematically, turning your expertise into working tests of how well Claude reasons in your field.
- Team up with other Fellows in your field to build environments that push Claude on the hardest, most judgment-heavy problems your discipline has to offer.
Minimum qualifications
- Are excited about the potential for AI to reason well about hard questions in their field where expert judgment matters.
- Hands-on experience using Claude and Claude Code in your day-to-day workflow.
- Hold (or are completing) a PhD in philosophy, cognitive science, economics, policy or law, or have equivalent research experience.
- Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-agency atmosphere for a few months and delivering concrete results.
- Existing authorization to work in the United States for the duration of the program.
Preferred qualifications
- Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or expert rubrics.
- Demonstrated expertise in your field, shown through research, scholarship, or expert-level analytical writing.
Representative projects
- A philosopher building hard cases that require normative judgment in ethics or formal epistemology.
- A cognitive scientist designing experimental-design and model-comparison tasks.
- An economist writing modelling and identification problems with ground truth.
- A policy scholar drafting regulatory and cost-benefit analysis tasks with expert rubrics.
- A legal scholar building AI-policy-relevant law datasets.
Logistics - Fellows
- The program runs from January 12th to May 8th 2027, and is full-time for the duration; some fellowships may be considered for an extension.
- Applications are open until October 28, 2026, and we plan to make offers by November 20th. Later stages will typically include a take-home exercise and conversations with our research team and potential mentors about your research interests and possible project directions.
- We ask that all Fellows attend a one-week in-person orientation in San Francisco.
- The default location is in San Francisco. We will consider remote engagements within the United States in certain circumstances.
- We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the United States.
- This is a fixed-term contract position. Fellows are engaged through an employer of record, rather than employed directly by Anthropic.
The below are Anthropic's policies for full time roles. These do NOT apply to the Fellows Program.
Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
